records.question: How can I track my order?
records.answer: You can track your order using the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email.

records.question: How can I return an item?
records.answer: Please contact customer support to confirm return eligibility and receive return instructions.

records.question: How can I check my refund?
records.answer: Please contact customer support to verify your refund status.

records.question: Hello
records.answer: Hello! Welcome to customer support. How can I help you today?
